description: Fires when the opponent threatens an immediate win in column 2 that I must block: strongest (activation 20-45) when they have three stacked vertically in column 2 with the cell above empty; moderate (2-15) when the playable threat cell is exactly row 3 of column 2 (third cell from the bottom) via a diagonal or row. Threats in other columns, unplayable column-2 threats, and positions with several must-blocks do not fire. Many weak near-threshold firings have no clear pattern.
effect: Pushes the move to column 2: forcing it high raises column 2 to 0.84-1.00 probability in tactical positions (+0.16 in a quiet one), taking mass from the model's other choices; zeroing it changes nothing measurable (redundant).
notes: Best dev F1 0.498 (P 0.84, R 0.35, AUROC 0.68). Column-2 specificity confirmed by minimal pairs (same vertical three in columns 0,1,3,4,5 gives ~0). Diagonal must-blocks in column 2 at rows 1/3/4 fire weakly or not at all; at row 2 they fire. Broadening to any column-2 threat cell collapsed precision (F1 0.16). Recall stays capped around 0.35 by diffuse near-threshold firing (act 1-4) in early/mid game, often with column 2 at height 2, that I could not explain. Simulation metric negative for all programs (-45% vs -70% for a perfect reader; share nan).
